Every group, every surface, what each one **becomes** after the click, and every action inside it. Crawled from the running app — the rail is the source of truth, so a screen added to the product appears here on the next sync and a deleted one disappears.

- **Surfaces:** 33 across 8 groups
- **Clean:** 33/33
- **Window width:** native
- **Crawled:** 2026-08-04T17:06:07Z
- **Regenerate:** `cd frontend && node scripts/ui_map_surfaces.mjs --sync`

Screenshots are written to `<tmp>/uimap/<width>/` and are deliberately not committed — 33 full-window PNGs per width would outweigh the rest of the frontend. The sync run also writes `ui-map-board.html` next to them, which is the same table with the shots inlined for eyeballing.
